query: alter alpha = 1 | windowcomp sum(alpha) sort alpha between -null and 0 as rolling
expectation: Unreviewed signed-null bound leaves output uncertain and suppresses dependent findings without a new syntax error

query: alter root = cbrt(-8), power_value = pow(-2, 3)
expectation: Adjacent negative numeric operands have bounded source-span nodes; no evaluation or general arithmetic precedence is implied

query: filter source_field not incidr ("synthetic-range")
expectation: Operator plus parenthesized RHS, not a one-argument function; input value is structural-only

query: alter result = incidr(source_field, "synthetic-range")
expectation: Operand-position function call remains distinct; no address/CIDR evaluation

query: filter (alpha = 1) and (beta = 2)
expectation: Explicit groups establish boundaries without guessed relative precedence

query: filter alpha not in (1, 2) | filter beta in (dataset xdr_data | fields beta)
expectation: Membership list and independent child query remain distinct

query: filter payload->branch = lowercase("AMBER")
expectation: Single comparison, path and closed call have explicit structural nodes

query: filter alpha = 1 or beta = 2 and gamma = 3
expectation: Mixed chain is ambiguous rather than assigned guessed precedence

query: alter alpha = 1 + 2 * 3
expectation: Arithmetic precedence remains unsupported; no invalid-expression error

query: alter shared = 1 | fields shared | join conflict_strategy = left (alter shared = 2 | fields shared) as child child.shared = shared
expectation: Left strategy preserves parent origin; both/unknown schemas remain conservative

query: alter alpha = 1 | fields alpha | union (alter beta = 2 | fields beta) | fields alpha, beta
expectation: Both branch names are candidates; no per-row existence or common identity claim

query: alter alpha = 1, beta = 2 | comp count() as total by alpha | filter total = 1
expectation: Grouping and explicit aggregate alias survive; beta is discarded; no implicit name/type inference

query: dataset = xdr_data | alter alpha = payload -> branch
expectation: JSON navigation is not a lambda declaration

query: dataset = xdr_data | alter alpha = arraymap(arraycreate(3), to_string("@element"))

query: dataset = xdr_data | alter alpha = concat("@element", "z")
expectation: Ordinary string has no callback binding

query: dataset = xdr_data | filter alpha !~= "z" and beta >= 3
expectation: Longest operator boundaries; precedence remains unverified
